text: Why is AIMD — additive increase, multiplicative decrease — the right control law?
choices: It is the simplest to implement
Chiu and Jain proved in 1989 that among simple linear schemes it converges to a fair and efficient allocation
It was the only one available
explanation: The choice was not arbitrary; there is a proof behind it. The resulting sawtooth is what anyone who has watched a TCP throughput graph will recognise.
